summary.headline: Veefin standalone FY26 operating revenue rose ~90% to INR 70.74 crore, with EBITDA margin at 53.89%; qualified pipeline is ~$80 million.
summary.overview: Management framed FY26 as a year of scale and platform build-out, positioning Veefin as a multi-product BFSI tech platform rather than a supply-chain finance (SCF) company. Standalone operating revenue rose from INR 37.32 crore to INR 70.74 crore, EBITDA margin expanded ~800 bps to 53.89%, and diluted EPS was INR 7 (up ~50%), while PAT margin fell on higher depreciation and finance costs. The management-view perimeter (Veefin Solutions, Estorifi, GlobeTF) reported INR 91.75 crore revenue and INR 44.7 crore EBITDA (48.7% margin). Management said FY27 will focus on execution, monetisation and conversion of the pipeline, with new product capex lower than FY26.

financial_highlights.change: PAT margin lower YoY on depreciation and finance costs

financial_highlights.metric: Management perimeter (Veefin Solutions + Estorifi + GlobeTF) FY26 revenue
financial_highlights.change: includes ~INR 21 crore from Estorifi and GlobeTF
after adding ~INR 253 crore from other group/service entities
Veefin product-level capex INR 107 crore; INR 130 crore on standalone-plus-perimeter basis

segments.name: Standalone (Veefin Solutions Ltd, listed entity)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 70.74 crore (up ~90%), EBITDA INR 38 crore at 53.89% margin, PAT ~INR 18.2 crore. Excludes Estorifi, GlobeTF and other group entities.

segments.name: Management product perimeter (Veefin + Estorifi + GlobeTF)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 91.75 crore, EBITDA INR 44.7 crore (48.7% margin), PAT INR 23.6 crore. Management intends to use this perimeter as the reporting lens after the amalgamation, which is with NCLT.

segments.name: PSB Xchange (platform)
segments.commentary: Corporate requirements of INR 22,000 crore; approved limits of INR 5,400 crore. 32 lender integrations (3 live, 5 WIP, 24 yet to start); 42 sourcing-partner integrations (6 live, 10 WIP, 26 yet to start). Pricing 65 bps, of which 15 bps covers onboarding manpower on Veefin's payroll (26 locations).

segments.name: White Rivers Media (group services entity)
segments.commentary: Described as a digital content creation and distribution company; DRHP expected around September with listing targeted this year. Veefin's stake amount not disclosed.

guidance_outlook: At least 25% of the ~$80 million qualified pipeline expected to convert within the next six months.
Product-IP capex in FY27 expected to be lower than FY26's INR 187 crore consolidated figure; no specific FY27 number given.
Amalgamation of Estorifi and GlobeTF into Veefin Solutions is with NCLT; post-merger promoter holding stated as 30%, rising to 39.41% after warrant exercise.
Eligibility for main-board migration expected by July 2026.
Decision on operating/management control of service subsidiaries expected closer to end of 2026.
Management expects at least a few international PSB Xchange-style JVs (six countries interested) to fructify in 2027.
capex_capacity: FY26 product-level capex INR 107 crore (Veefin, Estorifi, GlobeTF); INR 130 crore on the perimeter basis; INR 187 crore consolidated including other step-down subsidiaries.
Capex capitalises reusable product IP; management says the product build cycle is nearing its end and FY27 new builds will be much lower.
Management declined to give a forward FY27 capex number.
PSB Xchange onboarding team: 26 locations, staff on Veefin's payroll, now also onboarding business brought by banks from outside the platform.
demand_pricing: Qualified enterprise pipeline close to $80 million across 58 active qualified banking opportunities; 75% non-SCF, 70% international (SE Asia, Middle East, South Asia ex-India; early Africa); India ~30%.
27 of 58 banks evaluating more than one product module.
Management said SCF pipeline itself has grown on a like-for-like basis; the non-SCF share rose because other products added to the pipeline.

PSB Xchange: 88 active corporate deals; approved limits INR 5,400 crore vs INR 22,000 crore requested. Incremental approval conversion was ~14% per the analyst's calculation, which management said understates eventual approvals as multiple banks can approve at different prices.
Distribution of approved limits to suppliers and dealers has begun; disbursement-level transactions expected to show up in the current quarter.

qa_highlights.question: What success ratio should be expected from the bid pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said conversion is much higher than one-third; at least 25% of the pipeline should convert over the next six months.

qa_highlights.question: What will promoter shareholding be post-merger?
qa_highlights.answer: Promoter holding will be 30% after the merger, rising to 39.41% once all warrants are exercised.

qa_highlights.question: What is the PSB Xchange transacted volume and ramp-up?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the platform is at the approvals stage; limit distribution to suppliers and dealers has started, so financing requests should show up in the current quarter. No transaction value was disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY26 and FY27 capex?
qa_highlights.answer: FY26 capex was INR 107 crore at product level, INR 130 crore perimeter, INR 187 crore consolidated. FY27 capex will be lower than FY26; no number given.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 7-year PSB Xchange exclusivity live and how is onboarding staffed?
qa_highlights.answer: Exclusivity started with the first bank onboarding. Onboarding staff are on Veefin's payroll across 26 locations, and banks are also using them for off-platform business.

qa_highlights.question: Are receivables and borrowings rising?
qa_highlights.answer: DSO improved to 99 days from ~130. Short-term borrowings rose because long-term debt due this year was reclassified; long-term debt relates to the White Rivers acquisition and is backed by FDs.

qa_highlights.question: Is securitisation still being pursued and what about Epikindifi?
qa_highlights.answer: Securitisation has been put on the back burner given the macro environment. Epikindifi is in arbitration over governance; it contributed under 2% of consolidated numbers and was loss-making.

risks_watch: Pipeline is not revenue; management guides only to ~25% conversion over six months. Converting the ~$80 million pipeline is the key FY27 test.
PSB Xchange throughput: approved limits (INR 5,400 crore) must be sub-allocated and drawn down; live lender integrations are only 3 of 32.
Receivables are still high at 99 days DSO, and total receivables have more than doubled, though revenue also rose sharply.
Borrowings: classification shifted to short-term; need clarity on the debt's purpose and repayment schedule.
Amalgamation with NCLT, warrant conversion and promoter stake change; White Rivers Media listing and stake value not yet disclosed.
Margin dilution from consolidated service subsidiaries; control model for these entities undecided until end-2026.
International PSB Xchange JVs are early-stage and subject to long timelines.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the multi-product narrative and pipeline mix, but cautious and deliberately non-committal on forward numbers: no FY27 capex figure, no revenue guidance, and no stake value for White Rivers Media. Management was defensive on borrowings and receivables, attributing the debt rise to reclassification and citing DSO improvement.
key_quotes: FY27 is going to be boring. It's going to be about execution.
So, the larger vision is very simple, that whenever banks should think of banking transformation, specifically in transaction banking and working capital, we want them to think of a veefin.
75% of this pipeline is non -supply chain finance.
Securitization was creation of a market. We do not want to spend time in creating a market as on date

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; management says at least 25% of the ~$80M qualified pipeline should convert within six months and FY27 capex will be lower than FY26, backed by a PSB Xchange approved-limit pipeline (INR 5,400 cr approved vs INR 22,000 cr requested) but no capacity additions or firm FY27 growth numbers.
